verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an official llms.txt index at scrapingbee.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is backed by many topic-specific agent-oriented text files (/llms/html-api.txt, data-extraction.txt, js-scenario.txt, cli.txt, and one per dedicated API), giving an agent structured docs to follow.
